decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - It is considered that this application for erection of a roof light  at 941 Great West Road would not  harm the appearance the existing Listed  Building or the character of  the surrounding area, and would protect neighbours' living   conditions.  The proposal is considered to be in accordance with Policies ENV B.1.1 (New Development),   ENVB 2.3 (Reuse of Redundant historic buildings), ENVB 2.7 (Alterations to Listed Buildings and Buildings of  Townscape character), E1.5 (Development involving loss or change in  employment  uses),  E2.4 (Improvement of Employment Premises 
sites), C 3.2 (New or Extended Health Facilities) and C 3.4 (Doctor's and  Dentists Surgeries) , within the Unitary  Development Plan (December 2003),
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
description: Installation of roof light to roof area
